text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty -> latency-alerts.prod.p99 fired at 1759876543. p99 > 3000ms for the last 5m. Service: inference-hosted-api. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/latency-hotpath. PD: page delivered to @oncall-rotor

jamie: acked on PD, taking initial lead. Looking at global histograms now. p95 ~ 450ms -> 1100ms, p99 ~ 3200ms. Not seeing 5xx spike yet.

jamie: quick triage — heat concentrated in US-WEST cluster, token-heavy requests (>=1024 tokens) dominating tail.

riley: seeing KV cache churn increasing — evictions/sec spiked x9 in last 2m. Related to a burst of large-chat requests. Logs: `kvcache.evictions=912, gc.p99=120ms`

anika: I'm provisioning +2 nodes into the US-WEST dedicated pool and increasing burst capacity to 20% to relieve backlog. ETA ~3m.

sanjay: customers reporting slowness in a couple threads, but no error rates. Customer-impact: degraded latency for long completions, interactive chat sessions feel laggy.

jamie: rolling a targeted traffic split to a lighter model variant for long requests (rollout: 5% -> 20% over 5m). This should reduce per-token latency and KV pressure.

maya: can we proactively warm prefixes / hot keys? Suggest: `tools/kvcache/warmup --source=recent --count=1000 --region=us-west`

jamie: kicking off warmup now. Also temporarily lowering max_batch_size for long-seq buckets to reduce queuing delay.

riley: pushed hotpatch to reduce KV GC frequency and bumped kernel selection timeout. Deployed to us-west sidecar. Watch p99.

incident-bot: PagerDuty -> alert acked by jamie at 1759876550. Auto-escalation suppressed for 10m.

jamie: p99 improved to ~900ms after scale + warmup + rollout. p95 ~320ms. Keeping PD open, monitoring for 30m. No rollback needed. :thumbsup:

jamie: handoff in 15m to morning oncall @riley. Note in handoff: monitor kvcache.evictions, model-variant traffic split, and customer reports channel.

riley: taking follow-up, will keep PD low for 30m and check back every 10m. If stable at 30m, we'll close the incident and write post-incident notes. :rocket:

jamie: thanks team — leaving the thread.

riley: quick follow-up — adding a short alert for kvcache.evictions > 500/min to avoid recurrence and scheduling a deeper postmortem to investigate root cause of the burst.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: incident still open, next escalation at 1759877160 if no further acks.
